title: Speaking — Memorable gifts
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on memorable gifts.

questions: Where do you usually spend time with friends?
How do you keep in touch with friends you rarely see?
What kinds of activities do you normally do together?
Do you prefer meeting one friend or a group?
When do people you know usually exchange gifts?
Are you good at choosing useful presents?

part2.topic: Describe a gift that was particularly well chosen.
points: why it suited the person who received it
part2.closing: and explain what this experience showed you about choosing gifts.

questions: Why do gift-giving customs vary between families and societies?
Have online shops changed the way people think about giving presents?
How has everyday life connected with memorable gifts changed for people of different ages?
